mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 5-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day return when FEDFUNDS is in bottom 25% historical range is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 5.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that stimulates economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%, or Rank IC for trigger condition is below 0.03 over last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment (UNRATE) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to severe economic downturn, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS < 5.0% AND UNRATE > 7.0% is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a severe recession triggering policy interventions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recovery is anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC for trigger condition is below 0.03 over last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return when HOUST is in top 25% historical range is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC for trigger condition is below 0.03 over last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the supply-side contraction signals an economic slowdown that triggers policy stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for trigger condition is below 0.03 over last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic expansion, driving stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return when HOUST > 1350 AND INDPRO > 102 is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
